rationale: The long thesis is un-invalidated: price still holds above the 9-EMA ($24.27) and well above the $24.14 stop, and the final coil candle printed by far the heaviest volume since entry (13.9k vs 0.2–4.5k) pushing to a new local high at $24.30 with the tape still risk-on (SPY +0.93%, sentiment 0.93). Six minutes at flat P&L with ATR of $0.02 is consolidation, not failure, and the defined risk (~$62 to the stop) versus reward (~$161 to $24.68) still justifies patience. A flip to short is rejected because price remains well above session VWAP ($23.32) and shorting directly into the thrice-tested $24.15–24.17 shelf offers poor risk/reward, while closing sacrifices a live, defined-risk setup for no mechanical reason.
